critical.issue: SSRF guard bypass. publicHost() in js/cloudivr-web/events.js only regex-checks the hostname string. Accepted (200): https://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/x, https://[::ffff:a9fe:a9fe]/latest (= 169.254.169.254 cloud metadata), https://[::]/x, https://100.64.0.1/x, and DNS names that resolve to private IPs (https://localtest.me/x → 127.0.0.1). No DNS resolution check at save or at delivery (DNS rebinding). 'Send a test event' then POSTs from the production server and shows the user the HTTP status. Expected 400 'Use a public web address…'. Fix: resolve host (dns.lookup all) and reject private/loopback/link-local/CGNAT/ULA/IPv4-mapped ranges at save AND at deliver time (axios custom lookup / agent), normalise ::ffff: addresses.

minor.issue: Without a JSON body → 500 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'type')' (events.js line 137 req.body.type). UI always sends a body so users unaffected; use (req.body || {}).type.
ringTimeout 5 or 90 silently clamped to 10/60 (ring-group.js line 26) — no 400, UI shows normal success toast, user never learns the value changed.

Claim filter only re-claims failed/no_funds/empty. If the process restarts while a row is 'working', it stays 'working' forever → UI shows 'AI summary on the way…' permanently and the Summarize button never returns. Add a staleness timeout (e.g. working older than 5 min is reclaimable).

ui_bugs.component: Settings → Call events → Signing secret (pages/settings/Webhooks.js Secret)
ui_bugs.issue: Eye 'Show secret' button does nothing with a real mouse/touch click; clicking the masked secret text toggles it instead (so trying to select/copy it manually – the hint in the 'Copy failed' toast – flips the mask). RCA: Secret is wrapped in <Field>, which renders a <label> (ui.js line 69). The click toggles show, then label activation re-dispatches a click to its first labelable descendant (the eye button) → toggles back. Verified: click log ['svg','webhooks-secret-toggle'] for one click; JS el.click() works. Fix: render the secret row in a <div> (not Field/label).

integration_issues.issue: Wallet debited correctly ($305.00 → $304.90) but top-bar balance keeps showing $305.00 until reload/next 30 s poll. Refresh shell summary after a successful summarize.

Summary text and action items hidden correctly, but the free-text mood pill (e.g. 'professional') still shows, and Logs search still matches hidden transcript/summary text (search 'Friday' narrows to the hidden voicemail row, leaking content by inference).

Evaluates SAVED rules only; with unsaved edits on screen the result doesn't match what the user sees and there is no 'save first' hint (Webhooks disables its test button while dirty – inconsistent). Also Try-a-text runs are excluded from 'Recent runs' by design (test:{$ne:true}); only real/simulated inbound texts appear there.

action_items: HIGH: harden webhook URL guard in js/cloudivr-web/events.js (IPv4-mapped IPv6, ::, 100.64/10, DNS-resolved private IPs, re-check at delivery time).
MEDIUM: Webhooks.js Secret row – replace <Field> (label) wrapper with a div so the eye button toggles and the secret text is selectable.
LOW: POST /webhooks/test null-safe req.body; ring-group ringTimeout out of range → 400 or UI min/max feedback; reclaim stale 'working' AI summaries.
LOW: refresh top-bar balance after Summarize; private mode should hide mood pill and skip hidden text in Logs search; Try-a-text 'save first' hint when dirty.
DESIGN: mobile secret field width, toast vs FAB overlap, clipped first number tab, Ring group card spacing, FR action tile overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: events.js publicHost(): string regex only; no DNS resolution; does not cover ::ffff:*, ::, 100.64/10, 198.18/15; deliver() doesn't re-validate → SSRF.
ui.js Field renders <label>; any Field that wraps buttons (Webhooks Secret) suffers double-click activation – audit other Field usages with buttons inside.
update.js is solid: once-per-build reload guard, dirty/call guard, 60 s throttle, dev-only sessionStorage simulation ignored in prod builds.
TextTriggersTab RuleCard uses key={i}; fine today because fully controlled, but local state added later would follow the index on reorder.
